description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh:
是否强制重启。取值范围：

-   true：强制重启。相当于典型的断电操作，所有未写入存储设备的缓存数据会丢失。

-   false：正常重启。

默认值：false
description.en:
Specifies whether to forcibly restart the servers. Valid values:

- true: forcibly restarts the servers. This operation is equivalent to the typical power-off operation. Cache data that is not written to storage devices on the server will be lost.

- false: normally restarts the instance.

Default value: false

description.zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 simple application server IDs. Separate multiple server IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
